args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's review. I read #coastal-team, #coastal-random, Moss's four Coastal digests and your public Pellucid cutover note.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)*
• Ticket #4419: `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. Open. Source: Moss's Coastal cheat sheet.
• Ticket PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). Hector, the night dispatcher at the Beaumont barge slip, raised it. Source: your 2025-12-08 cutover recap.
• Bug with no ticket number: CSV import on the Berth 2 yard map. Source: the same recap, which called it "lingering" at cutover. I can't see whether it was fixed.

*Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)*
• Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, asked for by their warehouse managers. Source: Moss's Coastal cheat sheet.
• Issue with no ticket number: the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. Engineering gave a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher. Source: the cheat sheet.
• Request with no ticket number: patched manifest CSV before the 06:00 shift. Source: Moss's 2025-11-02 digest.

*Check before the review:* ticket #4419 is described two ways. The cheat sheet puts it on PHL (the Yard_Dwell_Summary timeout). Moss's 11/2 digest says Kwame's port account logged #4419 for barge slip 7 schedule sync, under Puget Sound, which looks like Driftmoor. I've listed it under PHL because the cheat sheet states it outright. Kwame should confirm which account it belongs to.

*Left out:* all Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark items (#8812, PD-4821). Also PD-4827 and PD-4824, which are Saltmarsh Provisions.

*Limits:* nothing in #coastal-team or #coastal-random mentions a PHL or Driftmoor ticket. The per-account ticket and CRM folders aren't in the files I can see. This list covers only what's in the channels and notes, so Kwame may want to check the ticketing system for anything else.
